content:
As the AirPods Pro 3 ongoing $50 discount continues, today's 9to5Toys "Lunchtime News" headline is Amazon taking $100 off all AirPods Max 2 colors, along with the latest AirTag 2 returning to its all-time low price of $22 each. We also have this 48GB 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro marked down by $400, the iPhone Air hitting a new all-time low with $159 off, and Best Buy's "Black Friday in July" sale officially kicking off. See below for details.

Get the brand-new AirPods Pro 3 this summer, now nearly $50 off, starting from $99

  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (originally $549)
  • AirPods Pro 3 $200 (originally $249)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (originally $129)
  • AirPods 4 (Active Noise Cancellation) $145 (originally $179)
  • AirPods 4 (Active Noise Cancellation) $119 (originally new $179) — Renewed Premium refurbished

Amazon takes $100 off the latest AirPods Max 2 across the board

Update: Amazon takes $100 off all AirPods Max 2 colors.

Alongside the AirPods Pro 3 ongoing $50 discount and the latest AirTag 2 returning to its all-time low price today, Amazon has also knocked $100 off the latest AirPods Max 2.

Amazon is selling Apple's 2026 AirPods Max 2 headphones for $449.

Down from $549, that's a straight $100 off and the lowest price we've found. Slightly below Best Buy's deal, this is the second-largest discount we've tracked for this latest Apple over-ear headphone since its launch earlier this year.

We saw the Max 2 briefly drop $150 during Prime Day, with some colors restocking intermittently throughout the four-day event. But aside from that, this is the lowest price ever on Amazon. It had never previously dipped below around $497.

While the Max 2 looks nearly identical to the previous AirPods Max (USB-C) generation, Apple delivers notable upgrades via the H2 chip — new amplifiers that take "audio quality to the next level," active noise cancellation boosted to "1.5x," camera remote control functionality, and the ability to just say "Siri" without having to say "Hey Siri" first.

Apple AirTag 2 returns to all-time low price, just $22 each today

Although the single-pack hasn't been discounted at the time of writing, Amazon has today brought back the all-time low price on the AirTag 2 four-pack that appeared during Prime Day.

Amazon has the AirTag 2 four-pack down to $89. Originally $99, the discount doesn't look huge on paper, but it's already one of the lowest prices ever and only the second time we've seen it at this level.

Although it's only 10% off, considering the four-pack already offers savings over buying singles, it works out to just $22.25 per AirTag — versus $116 for four at single-unit retail.

Today's four-pack deal marks the return of the all-time low price Amazon offered during 2026 Prime Day, roughly a month ago. Since its launch earlier this year, this is only the second time we've tracked this bundle at this low.

AirTag 2 features an upgraded ultra-wideband and Bluetooth chip, extended connection range, 50% louder speaker, and "broader Precision Finding." Here's what you need to know about the latest AirTag:

  • AirTag 2 vs AirTag: a look at all the new features
  • The good news and bad news about upgrading to AirTag 2

This 48GB 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro is $400 off today

Beyond the AirPods Pro 3 deal, the return of the AirTag 2 all-time low, and the $100 off AirPods Max 2, Amazon is still essentially offering the best price on the base new-generation MacBook Pro model (details below). But we also wanted to highlight this 48GB 14-inch M5 Pro model, which is down $400 off the new retail price at B&H.

B&H has the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro with 48GB RAM and 1TB storage down to $2,699. Originally $3,099, that's $400 below retail and the best price we've found.

Apple's own store still has this at $3,099, and Amazon is completely sold out of the 48GB RAM version. So aside from authorized Apple resellers like B&H, finding a deal on this upgraded M5 Pro has been tough — let alone a $400 bargain.

That said, Amazon is also running deals on some of the more affordable new-generation MacBook Pro configurations as well as higher-end models:

  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 16GB/1TB $1,849 (originally $1,999)
  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 24GB/1TB $2,049 (originally $2,199)
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB $3,299 (originally $3,599)
  • 16-inch M5 Max MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB $3,999 (originally $4,399)

iPhone Air hits "Black Friday in July" all-time low, $159 off

In addition to the ongoing summer AirPods Pro 3 deal, there are more new Apple discounts this week: the AirTag 2 returning to its all-time low and $100 off AirPods Max 2. We're also seeing the brand-new unlocked iPhone Air models marked down by $159, one of the best prices ever.

As part of Best Buy's "Black Friday in July" sale, all Apple iPhone Air models are $160 off retail:

  • iPhone Air 256GB $840 (originally $999)
  • iPhone Air 512GB $1,040 (originally $1,199)
  • iPhone Air 1TB $1,240 (originally $1,400)

Since the iPhone Air launched in fall 2025, Best Buy has consistently been the best place to buy. This ultra-thin Apple phone previously maxed out at $149 off (as we mentioned in early June), and now all models are $10 cheaper than our last mention — the lowest price recorded from a reputable source.

Amazon does have some used and refurbished units cheaper, of course, but if you want a brand-new unlocked version, Best Buy is the place to go.

Amazon takes $100 off the most affordable 42mm and 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 models

In addition to this morning's AirPods Pro 3 discount, Amazon is also running solid deals across Apple Watch Series 11 models, up to $100 off.

While not every color/band combination is at its lowest, the 42mm and 46mm Series 11 are down to $299 and $329 respectively:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (originally $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (originally $429)

These prices are essentially in line with the best deals on the aluminum GPS version outside of Prime Day — arguably the most popular model in the current lineup. During this year's Prime Day they were nearly all $120 off, but that was the only time we've seen better than the current $100 discount if you wanted to pick your case color.

Worth noting, the aluminum GPS + Cellular versions are now also $100 or more off, and the higher-end titanium models are up to $120 off at Amazon. The former had previously seen discounts of $130, while the latter has seen some savings of $150 or more.

Best Buy's "2026 Black Friday in July" officially kicks off! In-store exclusives, AirPods Max 2, TVs, appliances, and tons of great deals

Today's accessory and charging deals:

  • Elevation Lab AirTag 10-year extended-life battery protective case, four-pack $36 ($9 each)
  • Anker's clamp-on desk universal power strip hits a new low, just $58
  • Ongoing: my personal favorite Anker Prime charging dock with display and wall-plug charger, just $70
  • LISEN 140W MagSafe 3 cable: buy two still cheaper than Apple's, now $20
  • SABRENT VOLTIK 8-port 252W charging station with LCD screen can charge 8 devices simultaneously, today just $63
  • Baseus X1 Pro solar security camera with AI recognition and dual-target tracking, now $130
  • Even lower: Nomad tracking cards 20% off — Pro, Air, Find My, Google Find Hub, etc.
  • Rare deal: Nomad USB-C keychain charging and data transfer tool down to $28

Amazon's Renewed Premium iPhone 17 Pro is $220 off today, up to $449 off

Although we've spotted decent deals on Amazon's refurbished iPhone 17 Pro before, the top-tier Renewed Premium discounts have never been particularly attractive. This time we're seeing up to $220 off the latest iPhone 17 Pro across all three colors compared to new retail pricing.

All of the below are sold and shipped directly by Amazon (not third-party sellers), in Renewed Premium condition — Amazon's highest-quality refurbished tier, backed by a 1-year Amazon Renewed guarantee and "original battery performance above 90%."

  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,279 (originally new $1,499)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,279 (originally new $1,499)
  • 1TB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,279 (originally new $1,499)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Cosmic Orange $1,199 (originally new $1,299)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Deep Blue $1,199 (originally new $1,299)
  • 512GB iPhone 17 Pro Silver $1,199 (originally new $1,299)

The spotlight here is on the 1TB models, which are $200 below Apple's direct retail and get you a brand-new unlocked 17 Pro straight away. The 512GB models are $100 off, though for some people that may not be tempting enough to skip a new device.

That said, these are already among the best Amazon Renewed Premium new-unit deals, but the "Excellent" refurbished tier is still slightly cheaper — the main differences being a 90-day Amazon Renewed guarantee and battery "capacity above 80% of original":

  • iPhone 17 Pro 512GB Deep Blue $1,107 (originally new $1,299)
  • iPhone 17 Pro 512GB Cosmic Orange $1,139 (originally new $1,299)
  • iPhone 17 Pro 512GB Silver $1,120 (originally new $1,299)
  • iPhone 17 Pro 1TB Cosmic Orange $1,240 (originally new $1,499)
  • iPhone 17 Pro 1TB Deep Blue $1,263 (originally new $1,499)

Woot's 17 Pro Max models up to $49 off — "factory sealed," with a "test sticker showing 100% battery health," delivered in "an elegant custom black box."

  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 512GB $1,300 (originally $1,399)
  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 1TB $1,450 (originally $1,599)
  • iPhone 17 Pro Max 2TB $1,550 (originally $1,999)

Apple's latest Magic Keyboard with Touch ID and numeric keypad hits its Amazon weekly all-time low

Last day: Nomad site-wide anniversary sale officially kicks off! Rare deals on MagSafe chargers, cases, watch bands, and more

Nomad has just launched one of its biggest discount events of the year, with deals spanning iPhone 17 leather cases, Apple Watch bands, charging cables, Find My tracking cards (we've heard they'll go on sale today but haven't seen them listed yet), the gorgeous Stand One Max 3-in-1 25W MagSafe charger, wallets, and more. In addition to sale section markdowns, some of the latest products are up to 30% off, and the official site has a number of rare direct discounts.

Nomad Anniversary Sale

The Nomad Anniversary Sale is one of the brand's biggest discount events of the year. Although the official site occasionally runs promotions, the brand sat out Prime Day entirely this year and, unlike many accessory makers, doesn't run sales every national holiday.

If you've had your eye on Nomad products, this is the moment to jump in. The Nomad Anniversary Sale runs from today through July 20, but like their other major discount events, the best deals are likely to sell out early.

Here's a snapshot of some highlights, plus a few products that rarely see direct cash discounts:

  • Titanium Apple Watch Stratos Band — 20% off
  • Apple Watch Sport Band — 25% off
  • Stand One 25W MagSafe Charger — 20% off
  • Stand One Max 3-in-1 25W MagSafe Charger — 20% off
  • Leather Mag Wallet with Find My tracking — 10% off
  • Nomad ChargeKey — 20% off
  • iPhone 17 Magnetic Leather Backplate — 30% off
  • Universal Apple Watch Charging Cable — 20% off
  • Leather MagSafe Wallet — 20% off
